metadata.document_title: The Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017
metadata.heading_title: Liability to Pay in Certain Cases

heading.title: Liability to Pay in Certain Cases

article.title: Liability of agent and principal.
article.content: Where an agent supplies or receives any taxable goods on behalf of his principal, such agent and his principal shall, jointly and severally, be liable to pay the tax payable on such goods under this Act.
article.html:
86Liability of agent and principal.

Section 86 · Chapter XVI · page 76 of the Act

Where an agent supplies or receives any taxable goods on behalf of his principal, such agent and his principal shall, jointly and severally, be liable to pay the tax payable on such goods under this Act.
